entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Oh, hello? I... I hope I can get some help. I've been a customer for years and I'm just so disappointed right now.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet I bought a while ago. I've just been so busy... and honestly, seeing it in the corner just makes me sad. I really needed that money for something else.
I understand. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's the Aero-Vent helmet. I just... I thought the color would be different in person. It wasn't what I expected at all.
Okay, thank you. I'm pulling up order VF88602 now... I see the helmet was delivered to you 79 days ago. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.

Seventy-nine days? Oh no... I was really hoping it wouldn't be an issue. The box is completely unopened, I swear. It's exactly as it arrived. I've been so loyal to VeloFit, I was hoping you could help me out.

I appreciate you explaining that, and thank you for your loyalty. Let me see... Okay, good news. According to our policy, standard items like this helmet are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Wait, really? Oh, that is such a relief. You have no idea.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're unfortunately outside that 10-day window, we can process this return for a full refund. We want to make sure you're happy with the gear you have, as rider safety is our top priority. I'm glad we could sort this out for you.
Thank you so much, David. That's fantastic news. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've really turned my day around. Thank you!
I'm happy to hear that. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
